name: A-OKVQA: Visual Question Answering Using World Knowledge
description: A-OKVQA (Augmented OK-VQA) is a knowledge-based visual question answering benchmark requiring world knowledge and commonsense reasoning beyond direct visual recognition. Built on 24,903 questions grounded in MS-COCO 2017 imagery, it evaluates models through both multiple-choice selection and direct open-ended generation accompanied by human-written rationales.
